labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Goal

What should this feature accomplish?

## Use Case

Where and how would this help? Describe the research workflow it improves (which stage, which kind of paper or thesis).

## Proposed Behavior

Describe the expected behavior in concrete terms. If it is a new script or command, name it and describe its inputs (files, flags) and outputs (tables, evidence lines, `RESULT:` line), and which free API it would call, if any.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Sources and verification (`scripts/scholar.py`)
- [ ] Gap, literature and full texts (`scripts/gapmap.py`, `scripts/comap.py`, `scripts/snowball.py`, `scripts/evidence.py`)
- [ ] Design and analysis (`scripts/instruments.py`, `scripts/effects.py`, `scripts/autopsy.py`, `scripts/analyze.py`, `scripts/analyze_sem.py`, `scripts/qual.py`)
- [ ] Journal, review and output (`scripts/journalfit.py`, `scripts/similarity.py`, `scripts/reviews.py`, `scripts/build_docx.py`, `scripts/package.py`, `scripts/watch.py`, `scripts/deliverables.py`)
- [ ] Agent instructions (`SKILL.md`, `references/`)
- [ ] University presets (`references/university-presets.json`)
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Other

## Notes

Add examples, references, or related issues.
